scope: All ten unique segmentable body binding roots used by the 36-task novel-scene suite; native-site camera convention inspected separately.
qualification: No simulator was launched, no live image was rendered, and no persisted PNG was compared in this audit. The executed test used the actual Python function ASTs against an XML-derived mock body hierarchy and asymmetric synthetic 320x320 segmentation. This proves the tested code paths and XML body ownership agree, not live camera calibration, visibility, settling, or saved-state equality.

camera_contract.review_native_site_mask: novel_scene_mask_geometry.render_region_mask current live box projection in top-left coordinates
camera_contract.native_site_qualification: Source inspection only in this audit. Native site masks are projected geometric box silhouettes, not occlusion segmentation or whole parent-body masks. Finite workspace rectangles use the existing diverse region helper.

test_method.mock_model: Parse the six source XMLs' object bodies recursively. Rename object to instance_main and prefix child names. Build body_parentid and geom_bodyid from direct XML children. Include world body index zero.
test_method.synthetic_segmentation: Initialize an int32 (320,320,2) array with type=5 and geom_id=-1; assign each XML geom id one asymmetric pixel at divmod(geom_id*173,320). Return this unchanged from mock sim.render.
test_method.bindings: Each test uses name=the exact body root, body_ids=[0], geom_ids=[], segmentable=True; actual verify_and_correct_body_ids resolves the placeholder to the expected root.
test_method.review_selector: body_prefix with the exact binding root name
test_method.task_override: _get_task_specific_geom_ids was replaced with an empty-list callback. Independent source inspection confirmed its stove-turn and exact wooden_cabinet_1_main training-release overrides do not apply to the four novel primaries or selected short/white cabinet drawers.
test_method.assertion: Both outputs are nonempty and np.array_equal(review_output, runtime_output[:, ::-1]) for each binding.
test_method.geom_count_qualification: Counts below are raw XML direct/descendant geoms, not compiled simulator counts. Robosuite may duplicate collision geoms as visual geoms, without changing the relevant body ownership.

selector_caveat.reason: Legacy drawer_part recognizes instance_cabinet_slot or instance_slot, but short cabinet bodies use instance_drawer_slot.

body_selection_conclusion: The review renderer always includes descendant bodies; runtime does so only when selected bodies own no direct geoms. None of these ten binding roots owns both direct geoms and child-body geoms, so this conditional difference does not change their geom selection.
independent_live_test_contract: Use the identical initialized current simulator state for both calls, without intervening steps, joint changes, camera changes, or extra settling.
Resolve corrected_bids against current names and assert the exact expected body root, never use placeholder [0]. Check no explicit or task-specific geom override applies.
Force image_size=320 and camera_name=agentview in both renderers; do not resize a 256 mask to compare it with a 320 PNG.

For segmentable bindings compare review render_body_mask with actual runtime.sim_mask_for_object_id using corrected_bids. For nonsegmentable bindings compare exact current region projection with the novel exact_region_mask adapter, not the parent body.
Require both outputs to exist and contain positive pixels, then require exact binary equality after horizontal mirroring of runtime only.
Separately compare the persisted PNG after restoring the exact state used for that PNG; loading a different accepted initialization or adding settlement steps invalidates a pixel-exact comparison.
